Background processes kept dying on this VM — recommend running via the gigaleak cron infrastructure which handles restarts. Command: 

    for i in $(seq 0 35); do
  s=$((i*104857600)); e=$((s+104857599)); [ $e -ge 3737106862 ] && e=3737106861
  n=$(printf 'eenee100m-%02d' $i)
  curl -sL -H "Range: bytes=$s-$e" "https://archive.org/download/CNleaks/Ed_Edd_N_Eddy.zip" -o "/tmp/$n" \
    && gh release upload ed-edd-n-eddy-cnleaks-v1 --repo mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-ed-edd-n-eddy "/tmp/$n" --clobber \
    && rm "/tmp/$n"
done
